test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre ( not necessarily in the same order). A sits second to the right of C and C is third to the left of D. B is not the neighbour of C. B is second to the right of E. only one person sits between D and G. G is second to the left of H.

What is the position of G with respect to C?
solution:
**Given:** Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) A sits second to the right of C and C is third to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/744c7d4c89c94f24c6121640f3467cd18c7da0fc37ad090936ff176a055519d1.png] 

2) B is second to the right of E.

3) B is not the neighbour of C.
